shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel
registers or bands organising the surface
justification: Both show low-relief animals in profile within framed panels, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be: A depicts long processional registers of many human figures with staffs and led animals, bounded by rosette and floral bands, while B shows a single horned quadruped above large double spirals and a small isolated figure, with a plain incised border. The dominant motifs — human procession versus abstract spirals — share no specific iconographic scheme, and the rendering conventions (naturalistic layered relief vs schematic incised outline) differ markedly.
